Yes.
Can I repost these resources?
Yes, but please don't claim them as yours/give credit.

Yes.
Can I distribute these edited resources?
Not mentioned, but since reposting the original resources is okay,
this too is probably alright. Just remember to give credit to vibrato.

You can use these resources in eventing/scripting resources.
You can use these resources in adult themed games.

posts.author: Astaltw
posts.body:
Here one of my big update! There come 14 new Helmet (+1 not new) inspired by many video games/manga and stuff and so on and so forth...
Spoiler:
15 Helmet icon for generator
Spoiler:
15 Helmet SV Female
Spoiler:
15 Helmet SV Male
Spoiler:
15 Helmet TV map sprite
Upcoming update: Will do their TV(map sprite) and their inventory iconset soon(for the 15+6 helmet done).
And will see what I can do about making some armor.
About my sword iconset, I think I will separate it in 2 section, the free ones and the copyright ones, and I think I will adapt them all in 288x64 because it seem that nobody really like to use plugin making huge weapon, correct me if I'm wrong?
(If you want me to do futuristic stuff I can try too, just let me know). And will do the SV battler of evil 3,5,8 if nobody do it soon.
I hope you like those helmet and that they will help you to add epic/mythic gear for your heroes, and like this post if you want me to work faster, because that help my motivation a lot.
Happy game making!
WIP:
EDIT1: One helmet added to the 14 => 15+6=21.
SV helmet 21/21, TV helmet sprite 7/21, iconset sprite 0/21, Evil 3,5,8 in progress.
EDIT2: TV helmet sprite 21/21. Thanks for the support people, it motivated me a lot!
There might need to do little adjustment to few of them depending of the hair style of the heroes you are making wear them(but it's not hard to edit such detail I think).
I would be glad to check recoloration or modification of them if you do them, so if you are willing to share what you make from this, post a link to them here if you don't mind. Or a link to the link that goes to them...
